functions.name: activity_events
functions.description: Canonical GitHub activity event envelopes keyed by event ID, with separate event actor, repository and organization roles. Payload remains an explicit coverage gap: pinned payload variants overlap and include an unconstrained PublicEvent object, so no fabricated JSON schema or untyped payload is exposed. Only the API-retained recent timeline is modeled: current GitHub.com documentation limits it to the past 30 days and at most 300 events, with 30s-6h latency. Reaching 300 fails rather than advertising a complete recent population. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/activity/events .

metrics.name: activity_event_count
metrics.comment: Distinct event envelopes within the explicitly retained API timeline; not complete issue, commit or release history.
